text: When did the right leg weakness and unsteady gait first begin, and have you noticed any recent changes in your memory or personality? I also need to know if you have experienced any recent head injuries or infections.

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any recent headaches, nausea, or visual changes, and do you have a history of cancer or autoimmune disorders? I also need to know if you have had any recent weight loss or fevers. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_with_contrast

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Disseminated, nonenhancing white matter lesions with no mass effect.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the subacute progression of cognitive and behavioral changes alongside the MRI findings, I need to rule out infectious or inflammatory causes. Have you had any recent fevers, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss, and do you have any history of HIV or other immunocompromising conditions? REQUEST TEST: CSF_analysis

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of alcohol abuse, vitamin B12 deficiency, or exposure to toxic substances? REQUEST TEST: Serum_B12_and_Folate

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal metabolic and infectious workup, I suspect a non-enhancing neurodegenerative or inflammatory process. Do you have a family history of early-onset dementia or movement disorders, and have you noticed any muscle stiffness or tremors? REQUEST TEST: EEG

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any muscle jerks, sudden startle responses to loud noises, or rapid eye movements? REQUEST TEST: Serum_14-3-3_protein

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid cognitive decline, behavioral changes, and MRI findings of non-enhancing white matter lesions with negative infectious and prion markers, I suspect a demyelinating disease like Multiple Sclerosis or a paraneoplastic syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Serum_Anti-Aquaporin4_and_Anti-MOG_antibodies

speaker: Doctor
text: With MS markers negative, I suspect an autoimmune encephalitis or paraneoplastic syndrome given the rapid behavioral and cognitive decline. REQUEST TEST: Paraneoplastic_Antibody_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: With all infectious, prion, and common autoimmune markers negative, I need to rule out a vascular or structural cause. Have you had any transient ischemic attacks or risk factors for stroke, such as hypertension or diabetes? REQUEST TEST: CT_Head_with_angiography

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the clinical presentation of rapidly progressive dementia, myoclonus-like symptoms (startle responses), and characteristic white matter changes on MRI, despite negative standard prion markers, I suspect a variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease or a similar rapidly progressive neurodegenerative disorder. DIAGNOSIS READY: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD)
